notes.title: Loco Limbo | Stream
notes.content:
Welcome to Loco Limbo !

A hilarious and chaotic physical survival sandbox game set on a mysterious island!
Master the bizarre ability to detach and control your own limbs as you try to survive...

Key Features:

Unique Limb-Control Mechanics: Detach and control your limbs to survive
Physics-Driven Sandbox Gameplay: Prepare for unpredictable laughs as you fling your limbs around in absurd situations.
Darkly Humorous Storyline: Unravel the mysteries of the island with a touch of humor.
Survival Challenges: Gather resources, build shelters, and fend off dangers in an ever-changing environment.
